propositions: On the agentic execution path, the accumulated tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input token cost to grow O(N^2) with respect to conversation turns.

The current cache_settings_for function sets only two of four available cache breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions), leaving anthropic_cache and anthropic_cache_messages unused for agentic workloads.

The warn_if_cache_ineffective telemetry predicate never fires for agentic runs because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero and masking the O(N^2) uncached input cost from observability.
Anthropic and Bedrock providers require different cache keys: Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control automatic caching and requires bedrock_cache_messages instead of anthropic_cache.

Adding anthropic_cache=True (Anthropic) and bedrock_cache_messages=True (Bedrock) to the agentic path enables incremental message-tail caching, reducing uncached input tokens from ~97,869 to ~10 on a representative 9-call multi-turn run.
